comparison.objective: Tune and lock a damper vs pay cable safely from a free-turning drum into a cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine rotary adjustment and locking vs continuous cable control, drum braking and connector placement.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable safe impacts with no drift vs connector seated, cable routed inside tape lines and drum stationary without an uncontrolled run.
comparison.reason: Dynamic observation appears in both, but drum-speed containment and deformable routing are different tested abilities from damper calibration. Missing rubric detail: the two versions differ in the exact definition of holding the cable, but neither approaches duplication.
